publications.name: Asymmetric AlGaAs/GaAs Quantum Wells in a Dielectric Environment: Electric-Field-Tunable Optical Properties
publications.summary: A theoretical study of linear and nonlinear inter-subband optical properties of asymmetric AlGaAs/GaAs quantum wells embedded in a dielectric environment and subjected to an external electric field. The work shows how dielectric mismatch and electric-field-induced Stark effects reshape confinement, modify selection rules, and enable tunable terahertz optical responses, highlighting applications in reconfigurable THz optoelectronic devices. Preprint
